author: Kenan Machado
title: AAC Technologies net profit rises 5.7%
text:
AAC Technologies reported a 5.7% increase in first-quarter net profit, supported by sales of audio chips and cost cuts at its camera-lens unit.
The Hong Kong-listed firm, an Apple Inc. (AAPL) supplier, said Monday that net profit for the three months ended March was 1.12 billion yuan ($176.9 million), up from CNY1.06 billion a year ago. Revenue rose 10% to CNY4.64 billion from CNY4.22 billion a year earlier.
The impact of a stronger yuan and changing products was offset by other income made on derivatives and investments, the company said.
AAC said it began shipping its new magnetic speakers for top-of-the line smartphones this quarter. Development work on ultra-thin camera lenses was also on track, it said.
Smartphone-component makers in Asia have come off a supply peak after the launch of flagship phones by Apple and Samsung last year. U.S.-China trade tensions haven't helped either, though AAC said it hasn't hurt business yet.
Shares of AAC were up 4.2% in Hong Kong at midday ahead of the earnings release.
